attempts.url: no vendor OpenAPI; Cloud Healthcare API v1 publishes a Discovery document

notes: Full coverage of the Cloud Healthcare API v1, converted from the verbatim Google API Discovery document (revision 20260616) committed as upstream.json. Every resource method (154 operations) and every Discovery schema (177 components) is modelled. The googlehealthcare adaptor calls this API through the googleapis SDK; the whole API is described here (not just the adaptor's operations) so a workflow can reach any endpoint via the generic builders.
